description: TEDACS estimates thermal efficiency for ocean thermal energy conversion around Cuba. Researchers at the Cuban National Institute of Meteorology and the Federal University of Pernambuco derive the measures from 27 years of the CMEMS global-ocean physical reanalysis. The study area spans 18.5–24 degrees north and 73.5–85.5 degrees west, using source data at one-twelfth-degree resolution. ScienceDB publishes the dataset free under CC0 1.0. The inspected metadata does not establish the output format or precise start and end years. Thermal efficiency calculated from ocean conditions is a resource-screening indicator for planning, not the output of a fully specified plant. It can help compare potential OTEC locations before detailed engineering and environmental constraints are applied. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
